item.description:
Please contact inquiry [at] lr.first.iir.isct.ac.jp if you have any question about our lab.

Some relevant sites:

  • Professor Manabu Okumura
    • https://strdb.s.isct.ac.jp/html/100002058_en.html
    • https://www.first.iir.isct.ac.jp/en/member/core1/#okumura
    • https://researchmap.jp/read0069366?lang=en
    • https://aclanthology.org/people/manabu-okumura/
  • Associate Professor Kotaro Funakoshi
    • https://strdb.s.isct.ac.jp/html/100002652_en.html
    • https://www.first.iir.isct.ac.jp/en/member/core1/#funakoshi
    • https://researchmap.jp/funakoshi.k?lang=en
    • https://scholar.google.co.jp/citations?hl=ja&user=UhXijg8AAAAJ

For prospective students:

  • Prof. Okumura will retire in March 2027 and is not able to accept new students.
  • Assoc. Prof. Funakoshi can accept students who enroll in Department of Informatin and Communications Engineering (ICT), School of Engineering.
    • He does not accept Research Stduents (研究生) who intend to enroll in the ICT Master’s course.
